name: Missy Elliott
hook: A Virginia songwriter and rapper who, with her fellow Virginian Timbaland, made strange, stuttering, funny records that sounded like nothing else on the radio, and became the first female rapper in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
blurb: Missy Elliott was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, on 1 July 1971. She and Timbaland, from nearby Norfolk, were part of DeVante Swing's Swing Mob, a group of young musicians around the R&B band Jodeci, and they began writing and producing songs for other singers together. Her first album, 'Supa Dupa Fly' (1997), was produced by Timbaland and reached number three. Its lead single, 'The Rain (Supa Dupa Fly)', and its videos, directed by Hype Williams, looked like science fiction from a Black point of view, Afro-futurism, and set her image. 'Get Ur Freak On' (2001) won the Grammy for Best Rap Solo Performance. 'Work It' (September 2002) layers samples of Run-DMC's 'Peter Piper', Rock Master Scott and the Dynamic Three's 'Request Line', Blondie's 'Heart of Glass' and Bob James's 'Take Me to the Mardi Gras', and plays one line of her rap backwards. It spent ten weeks at number two, held off by Eminem's 'Lose Yourself'. In 2019 she became the first female rapper in the Songwriters Hall of Fame, and in 2023 the first in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
